title: Cashea, Venezuela's largest fintech startup that offers a banking and payments app, raised a $40M Series A, including $20M in debt, and a $60M Series B (Maria Clara Cobo/Bloomberg)
summary: Maria Clara Cobo / Bloomberg: Cashea, Venezuela's largest fintech startup that offers a banking and payments app, raised a $40M Series A, including $20M in debt, and a $60M Series B — Cashea, Venezuela's largest financial technology company, has raised $100 million across two financing rounds, as global investors bet …
